name: bazelisk
role: Bazel's launcher, the graph's one bootstrapped tool (docs/build-graph.md#environment): it downloads the Bazel release .bazelversion names, verifies it against .bazeliskrc's digest, and runs the graph's front door (bazel/bazel) in its place. Every other tool the graph runs is declared in the graph.
why_not_gated_like_ptxas: bazelisk only launches Bazel; it touches neither codegen nor an action. Its version is pinned by digest, not ranged, because a launcher that differs by host is a graph that differs by host: the digest is the identity (the release prints no version without downloading a Bazel).
